meta.title: Founding with Confidence — Strategy & AI for your start | Ebmeyer Consulting
meta.description: For founders: in 12 weeks from idea to a validated model, a clear 12-month plan and your own AI assistant.

hero.title: Founding with Confidence
hero.audience: For founders on the way into self-employment
hero.lead: You start with a clear strategy, validated assumptions and your own AI assistant beside you. In control, from the very first step.

pain.title: You want to start. But the beginning feels enormous.

items.title: A thousand thoughts, no clear thread.
items.body: You have ideas, experience and energy. But no clear path to which idea actually holds and where to begin.

items.title: You're planning blind.
items.body: Business model, audience, pricing: much of it comes from instinct, without real market signals. You carry the risk alone.

items.title: AI could help — but how?
items.body: Between hype and a thousand tools you're missing the strategy to use AI meaningfully for your build from the start.

items.title: The most honest question.
items.body: How much longer do you want to deliberate, research and hesitate instead of starting properly with a clear plan and validated assumptions?

pain.pull: There is another way. Confident, strategic, validated, and with you in the lead.

cost.title: Every month spent hesitating costs you more than what's on the invoice.

rows.body: Months spent planning and researching instead of learning from the market what actually works.
Energy that drains into doubt and uncertainty instead of flowing to your first real clients.
The market doesn't wait. Whoever validates and starts early learns faster than whoever is still planning.

cost.statBody: In 90 days from a validated plan to a concrete go-to-market, instead of months in planning mode.
cost.statNote: Not a promise of success, but a clear, validated path from idea to start.

approach.title: You don't need a perfect plan. You need clarity, validation and a start.
approach.lead: Founding with Confidence isn't a business plan course. It's the path from «I have an idea» to «I have a validated model, a clear plan, and I'm executing it».

cards.title: Strategy and system
cards.body: You get a clear direction, a well-considered business model and positioning that sells. You know what you stand for, who you serve, and why you.

cards.title: Validate first, invest second
cards.body: Before you commit time and money, we test your assumptions against real market signals. You invest in what is genuinely in demand.

cards.title: AI from the very start
cards.body: Your own AI assistant supports you from the first hypothesis: sharpening ideas, structuring the build and taking routine off your hands.

cards.title: From real experience
cards.body: 21+ years of practice and people already working with me: from corporates to e-commerce solopreneurs, coaches, consultants and therapists.

items.title: … want to take the leap

items.title: … want to validate their idea
items.body: Before investing time, money and security.

items.title: … are looking for solid positioning
items.body: A business model, target client and offer that fit from the start.

items.title: … want to use AI from day one

items.title: … want structure & a plan, not chaos

journey.title: Clarity first. Then validation. Then the build.
journey.lead: You start with Phase 1, your foundation. Phase 2 validates your assumptions against real market signals before you invest. Phase 3 turns the validated model into a concrete plan and your start.

steps.label: Phase 1 · Foundation
steps.name: Clarity & Positioning
steps.body: Clarity about you, your direction and a first business case hypothesis.

steps.label: Phase 2 · Validation
steps.name: Hypotheses & Business Cases
steps.body: You test your assumptions against real market signals before you invest.

steps.label: Phase 3 · Execution
steps.name: From Plan to Build
steps.body: The validated model becomes a concrete 12-month plan and your start.

journey.pull: Phase 1 gives you clarity. Phase 2 gives you certainty. Phase 3 gets you moving.
journey.note: The phases build on each other and lead you step by step from idea to start.

phases.title: Clarity & Positioning
phases.sub: Clarity about you, your idea and your positioning.
gains: A sharp profile of your strengths, values and story
A clear direction and a business case hypothesis, from which your company description and strategy framework emerge (ICP, sales matrix)
A finished AI assistant trained on you
phases.format: 1× 30 min kick-off + 3 sessions of 2 hrs across 4 weeks, templates included.
phases.ideal: … you want out of the mental loop and into a clear direction.

results.body: Your strengths, values and story as the foundation for your profile.
A clear first assumption about who you serve and with what.
What you stand for, sharply put and in your voice.
Trained on you and your idea, working from day one.
Your closing result and the handover into Phase 2.

phases.glossary: ICP (Ideal Customer Profile) = your ideal type of client. Sales matrix = the thread from first approach to close. Business case hypothesis = a reasoned assumption that your idea is economically viable.

phases.title: Hypotheses & Business Case Simulation
phases.sub: Before you invest, you test your assumptions against real market signals.
gains: A first market validation of the hypotheses selected after Phase 1
Up to 2 fully calculated business case scenarios instead of gut feel
A sharp ideal customer profile with personas and a sales matrix
phases.format: 1× 30 min kick-off + 3 sessions of 2 hrs across 4 weeks, templates included.
phases.ideal: … you want to lower your risk and build on facts rather than hope.

results.body: We test the hypotheses selected after Phase 1 against real market signals.
Up to 2 scenarios, fully calculated and sharpened with your AI assistant.
You know who you're speaking to and how you sell.
A high-level view of revenue, costs and growth.

phases.glossary: Market validation = real signals from the market on whether demand exists. Business case = a fully calculated scenario for viability. Personas = typical client profiles within your audience.

phases.title: From Plan to Build
phases.sub: The validated model becomes a concrete plan and your start.
gains: A roadmap for your own capabilities
Further automations for your daily work
phases.format: 1× 30 min kick-off + 3 sessions of 2 hrs across 4 weeks, templates included.
phases.ideal: … you want to commit and start now, rather than keep planning.

results.body: Milestones, priorities and resources at a glance.
What you still need, laid out clearly as a roadmap.
We evaluate together how to automate more of your activities.

phases.glossary: AI use case map = an overview of where AI gives you the most leverage.

outcome.title: Imagine starting with a clear plan you can act on immediately.

items.body: business model, positioning and plan are in place before you invest.
validated business case scenarios and a three-year view give you certainty.

items.lead: Your AI assistant is beside you:
items.body: supporting you from day one, in your voice.
a clear 12-month plan with milestones, step by step.
independent, confident, with a clear head.
